sentences.en: The soundtracks of most video games are mostly ambient music.
sentences.zh: 大多数视频游戏的配乐主要是环境音乐。

sentences.en: Music is the soundtrack of your life.
sentences.zh: 音乐是你生活的背景音轨。

sentences.en: My friend composes soundtracks for video games.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友为视频游戏创作原声。

senses.zh: 声道,音带，声带,声迹,电影配音
